high_level_description: This image is a comparison of the Martand Sun Temple at two different time periods: 760 AD and 2018 AD. Text: "Year 760 AD" Image: A detailed black-and-white illustration of the Martand Sun Temple as it was in the year 760 AD. The temple appears to be a grand structure with multiple domes, intricate carvings, and a large courtyard. There are also smaller buildings surrounding the main temple, and the landscape includes trees and open fields. Mood: The mood is historical and majestic,
